name: tsunami
description: A tall breaking wave above a separate water line.
useCase: Show a tsunami warning in coastal weather or emergency information.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The curled tip sits farther from the outer slope, keeping the full crest and wave face clear above the water line.

24.reason: The full curling crest leaves clear space beside the outer slope and above the separate water line.
